past passive participle form as given

items.question: By what count and in what contexts are certain beings said to endure torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant units.
Those units are identified as thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings within those womb-diagrams are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Torment is ascribed to beings located within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings undergoing torment remains unspecified.
The cause of torment is not indicated by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
